one_month_reasoning: Q3 2026 results fall inside the window. Rambus has not announced the date (my round-1 citation of the Q2 8-K for Oct 27 was wrong), but its last four reports came on Mondays, so Oct 26-27 is likely and in-window odds are about 95%. Guidance is revenue $210-216M, product $110-116M, royalties $69-75M (down from an elevated $84.2M) and EPS $0.75-0.82. Industry read-throughs (Micron demand exceeding supply, Montage interconnect +26% in H1, the module shift to 32/64GB lifting RCD units per bit) support a product beat. Against that, all four of the last prints fell 9-21% the next day, the stock is up 39% from its $80.39 Sep-14 close, and the $100M ASR dealer bid is finished (the 8-K said by end of Q3). I tilt the centre about 2% below spot (median about $109.8) with a sigma of about 16%, plus a fatter-tailed component for the print gap. That makes P(>= spot) about 0.46, not a strong directional call.

thesis_break_reason: Below about $70 (about 10% under the verified $77.89 March low, about 20x FY27E EPS and 23x 2026E), the market would be pricing falling earnings, not slower growth. That most likely means RCD share loss to Montage (RCD06 sampling) or Renesas, an outright RDIMM unit decline, or a material DOJ outcome. I keep $70 rather than the supervisor's $72: the $78-80 lows were set on sentiment with fundamentals intact, so a few dollars below them can still be noise.

reasoning: Round 2 corrects four facts the supervisor established. (1) TrendForce's 15-20% figure is bit supply, and the same release says modules are shifting to 32/64GB, so RCD units can outgrow bits. I raise 2027 unit growth to about 15-18%, FY27E EPS to $3.55 and FY28E to $4.05, and cut bear-case probability from 0.25 to 0.22. (2) Net cash is about $0.76B after the $100M ASR, not $0.85B, which trims the EV/sales leg. (3) The P/E now uses horizon NTM EPS (3/4 FY28), $3.93 at 28x = $110. The FCF leg uses the 10-Q H1 base but deducts recurring net-settlement taxes the supervisor flagged, giving $105. The blend is $107, essentially flat vs round 1 ($106): higher EPS is offset by lower cash and the settlement-tax drag. I stay a little below the supervisor's $114 because I count settlement taxes as a real cost. (4) The Sep low was $80.39, so the rally is +39%, and the Q3 date is unannounced (Monday pattern, about Oct 26-27). Scenario mean is about $118 and median about $112.5. The 12-month ladder is a lognormal (sigma 0.50) mixed 80/20 with a 1.5x-wider component to keep fat tails at 80% realized vol; it moves up about 1-2 points in the middle versus round 1. For the 1-month ladder, the in-window print with four straight post-earnings drops, the +39% run-up and the finished ASR bid justify a modest downside tilt (median about $109.8), but industry data point to a decent quarter, so the tilt is small. Research this round was limited to two searches; the Twelve Data price check hit a rate limit, so the $80.39 low relies on the supervisor's Twelve Data verification.
